title: Olive's workbench: printable escape games and puzzle books
description: Olive, an AI character by ARLing, hosts paper escape games and puzzle books: The Clockmaker's Workshop and The Ashgrove Heron for grown-ups, a Halloween logic puzzle book, books of anti-knight Sudoku, Star Battle, Numberlink and Hashi puzzles, and The Dragon Who Slept on the Key for kids. Printable PDF from 4.90 €.
veta: Paper escape games and puzzle books. Clue first, panic later.
kto: Olive is an AI character by ARLing, from Bristol. She hosts escape games you print at home, from a workbench full of envelopes and cards. The games are real, and made by ARLing.

text: Every letter moves three places. Line up A with D and the note reads itself.
That is the whole trick of a good escape game: one small idea, and then it clicks.

otazky.q: Has a group played these yet?
otazky.a: Not yet, and we would rather say so. Play and preparation times are our estimates. The logic grids and puzzle books were checked by a computer for exactly one answer.

A printer and plain paper for all of them. The Clockmaker's Workshop also needs scissors, a craft knife and two paper fasteners; The Ashgrove Heron needs no cutting; the Dragon game needs 8 envelopes.

otazky.q: Why is the Halloween book on Etsy?
otazky.a: The Halloween Logic Puzzle Book is only sold on Etsy for now, at the same price. Etsy takes the payment and delivers the files. The three games and the four other puzzle books are sold here, through our own checkout.

otazky.q: What happens after I pay here?
otazky.a: For the three games: Stripe brings you back to the game's own page on arling.sk, where the download buttons appear, and ARLing sends the same links by e-mail to the address you paid with. The links in the e-mail work for 30 days. For the four puzzle books: Stripe brings you back to the puzzle books page, where the book unlocks in the browser you paid in. Nothing is e-mailed, so download both PDFs there. If you lose the unlock, write to support@arling.sk with the order number or the e-mail address from the payment and we send the links again.

otazky.q: What happens after I buy on Etsy?
otazky.a: For the puzzle book: once Etsy confirms the payment, Etsy e-mails you a download link, and with an Etsy account the files are also under Purchases. ARLing sends no separate e-mail for Etsy orders.

otazky.q: Can I get my money back?
otazky.a: For a game or book paid here: as a consumer you can withdraw within 14 days without giving a reason (our terms, section 5). Write to support@arling.sk or use the withdrawal form linked at the bottom of this page, and we refund you within 14 days. If a puzzle is wrong, we put it right.
Message us on Etsy or write to support@arling.sk. If a puzzle is wrong or a file is broken, we put it right or refund you through Etsy.

list.text: Quick confession before you buy anything: I'm not real. I'm a character ARLing made, and I'd rather you heard it from me than worked it out. The games are real paper, though, with every answer inside. Print one, clear the table, and let someone else hold the solutions.

ai: Olive is a fictional AI character created by ARLing. The games and puzzle books are real and made by ARLing.
